How many distinct six-digit codes are listed?

2.stem:

21.stem: Four numbers are given. Three follow the same divisibility rule. Select the odd one out.
21.review: The source options (112, 124, 132, 216) did not support the previously claimed divisibility-by-three explanation. In the reviewed version 132 is replaced by 136: the other three values are divisible by 8, but 124 is not. Original options and published key are preserved in Original PDF.
21.explanation: The revised options create a single clear intended numerical property: three are multiples of eight. The previous solution incorrectly claimed three original choices were multiples of three.

29.stem:

A. Electoral college for Presidential election
B. Qualifications to be President
C. Term of office of the President
D. Ground for impeachment: violation of Constitution
I. Article 58
II. Article 56
III. Article 61
IV. Article 54
Select the matching sequence A B C D.

32.stem: At which city were the rifle events of the 67th National Shooting Championship (2024) held?
32.review: The national championship was contested at more than one venue. This question specifies the rifle competition held at Bhopal.
32.explanation: The national championship was contested at more than one venue. This question specifies the rifle competition held at Bhopal.

41.stem: Under the regular statutory provision for anticipatory bail (section 482, BNSS), which courts may entertain an application?
opts: The High Court and the Court of Session
Any criminal court, including a magistrate
Only the High Court and Supreme Court
41.review: The statutory anticipatory-bail jurisdiction under BNSS section 482 (CrPC section 438 previously) is the High Court or Court of Session; the original adds the Supreme Court under a different jurisdiction.
41.explanation: The statutory anticipatory-bail jurisdiction under BNSS section 482 (CrPC section 438 previously) is the High Court or Court of Session; the original adds the Supreme Court under a different jurisdiction.

63.stem: A histogram shows 115 students’ marks, with equal-width score classes. A student qualifies if the score is above 40.5. Find the ratio of qualified to non-qualified students from the histogram.
63.review: Make the class-width implication explicit: frequencies are proportional to bar heights because all histogram class intervals have equal width.
63.explanation: Make the class-width implication explicit: frequencies are proportional to bar heights because all histogram class intervals have equal width.

67.stem: A can finish a job in 6 days, B in 8 days and C in 24 days. They start together. How many days will the entire job take if C is scheduled to leave after 3 days?
67.review: All three finish the work in precisely 3 days, so C departs only when the project is already completed.
67.explanation: All three finish the work in precisely 3 days, so C departs only when the project is already completed.

87.stem: Convert to passive: “Suruchi observed that the fish had a very large dorsal fin.”
opts: It was observed by Suruchi that the fish had a very large dorsal fin.
It had been observed that the fin is possessing the fish.
Suruchi was observed having a fin by the fish.
The fish was observed Suruchi to have a fin.
87.review: The original passive voice of “exclaimed that” is unnatural. This is changed to the conventional report verb “observed,” with a grammatical passive construction.
87.explanation: The original passive voice of “exclaimed that” is unnatural. This is changed to the conventional report verb “observed,” with a grammatical passive construction.

88.stem: Identify the incorrect part: The ruling party (A)/ has announced (B)/ that it will supporting the bill (C)/ during the coming session. (D)
88.review: The error is the ungrammatical “will supporting”, which should be “will support”; avoids the original disputed use of singular “their”.
88.explanation: After will, use the base form of the verb: will support.

98.stem:

A. A sunrise sector can become a sunset sector in less than a decade, leaving its revenue model disconnected from influence, trust and reach.
B. One defining lesson I learnt in three decades as a journalist is also a life skill applicable to many fields.
C. It is about navigating change while retaining core values and principles.
D. Technology advances rapidly, geopolitics shifts continually, and industries must adjust to new realities.
98.review: The source sentence D is visibly incomplete. Completed it without introducing new facts; BCDA remains the coherent order.
98.explanation: The source sentence D is visibly incomplete. Completed it without introducing new facts; BCDA remains the coherent order.
